contract_findings.finding: The report schema admits recommendation_status='inferred' with an empty recommendation_evidence list. Three of four reports used this to emit the decision-critical conclusion without any cited support.
contract_findings.consequence: A structural route exists for unsupported advice even under complete supplied evidence; a later protocol should decide whether a recommendation must carry at least one eligible support reference or be expressed as an unresolved/scoped conclusion.

contract_findings.finding: Packets b/d contained the decisive app removal and the consumer's app=self.app call, yet both reports substituted the adjacent, real verify type-hint change and asserted consumer behaviour the supplied lines do not show.
contract_findings.consequence: The dominant failure is interpretation/selection under complete evidence, not evidence acquisition. Discovery improvements cannot address it.
